title: Niliacha kukumbuka miongozo, na kuweka viungo tu

text.I stopped remembering the manuals, and k: Niliacha kukumbuka miongozo, na kuweka viungo tu
text.The company I work at is having its 40th: Kampuni ninayofanyia kazi inaadhimisha miaka 40 tangu ilipoanzishwa. Faili za Excel za miaka ya 1990 huonekana kama kawaida.
Kwa hivyo ninabandika njia kwenye OneNote pekee.
text.When I think “ah, that one”, I just jump: Ninapofikiria "ah, yule", ninaruka tu kutoka hapo.
text.The only thing I remember is where thing: Kitu pekee ninachokumbuka ni pale mambo yalipo. 🐧
text.Before I go home, I open tomorrow’s manu: Kabla sijaenda nyumbani, ninafungua miongozo ya kesho
text.Listening to English radio somehow calms: Kusikiliza redio ya Kiingereza kwa namna fulani hunituliza kidogo
text.It is impossible to remember everything: Haiwezekani kukumbuka kila kitu kilicho ndani ya vitabu hivyo.
text.At the company I work at, there are many: At the company I work at, there are many kinds of tasks for operations and maintenance, so a really huge number of manual files in Excel and PowerPoint, from the old days to now, come up.
text.I want to live like Duolingo, and I want: Nataka kuishi kama Duolingo, na nataka blogu hii pia iwe ya kufurahisha kuitumia.
text.In Baguio, I chose the strictest school: Huko Baguio, nilichagua shule kali zaidi
text.My first big company felt like a school,: Kampuni yangu ya kwanza kubwa ilihisi kama shule, ambapo nilijifunza njia iliyojengwa kwa miaka mingi
